entities.name: Makindi
entities.description: Vast mesa-riddled plains in Ondu on Zendikar, once seat of an ancient Kor empire.

entities.name: Kor empire
entities.description: Ancient empire that collapsed after a civil war between the city and its Skyclave.

entities.name: Omnath
entities.description: Primal embodiment of Zendikar's chaotic mana, once imprisoned.

entities.name: Binding Circle
entities.description: Ritual site enclosing the broken Prison of Omnath.

entities.name: Prison of Omnath
entities.description: Shrine that held Omnath until its breach.

entities.name: Soul Stair
entities.description: Endless spiral staircase below the pit.

entities.name: Ritual of Lights
entities.description: Rite performed twice yearly with seventy-seven candles to keep Omnath bound.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Titanic beings explorers hope to find weapons against.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker who crossed Makindi in 4557 AR.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Planeswalker who crossed Makindi in 4557 AR.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: Traveler who crossed Makindi with Nissa and Sorin.

entities.name: Smara
entities.description: Kor prophet met by the travelers.

events.summary: The Kor empire collapses after a civil war between the city and its Skyclave; the Skyclave falls onto Jwar Isle, fracturing the land into the Trenches.
events.quote: The Skyclave fell onto Jwar Isle , fracturing the land into the Trenches seen today.

events.summary: Pilgrims' rites fail as wild mana breaks the circle, releasing Omnath.
Nissa, Sorin and Anowon cross Makindi, endure the Roil, meet the kor prophet Smara and battle hazards.

relations.quote: One prominent mesa hosts the Binding Circle
Nissa Revane , Sorin Markov , and Anowon crossed Makindi
